LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Tarbosaurus.label: Tarbosaurus
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Tarbosaurus.description: A bipedal heavy mech nicknamed the "armored rex", characterized by a body structure like a carnivorous dinosaur and two powerful artificial-muscle bionic legs. In the arms race of humanity's early space age it was the much-anticipated next-generation weapon that brought together countless cutting-edge technologies, and the earliest recorded unit to enter service using artificial muscle to drive its joints.\n\nIts enormous size on the battlefield, its hard-to-maintain artificial muscle bundles, and the beam weapons and railguns that never became practical during its service life meant it ultimately failed to change the structure of modern warfare. Even thousands of years later, however, countless manufacturers have acquired the production technology to replicate and improve on its design, and traces of its technology can be glimpsed in countless weapons that came after it.
